name: Spark Run
summary: Run Windows programs on Wine, or install them as apps with their own folder and menu entry.
summary_fr: Lancer des programmes Windows sur Wine, ou les installer comme applications avec leur propre dossier et entrée de menu.

optional.PIL: program icons as PNG (else the .ico is used as is)
optional.kdialog: Plasma's file dialog for Run a program
optional.xdg-open: opening C: folders, the log and the switching guide

needs.system: x86-64 Linux with the libraries Wine loads (X11, FreeType, fontconfig, GnuTLS; Vulkan for DXVK). The SparkOS image has them all.

data: ~/.local/share/spark-run (Wine, Wine Mono, one prefix per app); --uninstall leaves it, remove it to free the space
